title: ProjectE quality gate receipt
description: Input contract for gate_receipt.py. The Python validator remains authoritative - it enforces cross-field rules JSON Schema cannot express (metric-leaf/semantic 1:1 binding, hash freshness against the filesystem, child-gate reduction, promotion chains). This file documents the structural shape.

schema.description: Legacy alias for schema_version. Accepted read-only and normalised with a warning; a conflict between the two is an ERROR.

parsed_metrics.description: Nested object whose LEAVES must be finite JSON numbers. bool, null, string, array and object leaves are rejected.

$comment: Rules this schema CANNOT express, enforced only by gate_receipt.py: every parsed_metrics leaf binds to exactly one metric_semantics record carrying definition/units/distance_semantics/region/sampling_step/geometry_model; every path resolves under --root; hashes must match the current file; DRC/ERC gates without --exit-code-violations and --severity-all are RED regardless of exit code; A-level gates require fault-injection evidence whose expected_failed_metrics are real metric leaves.
